ctx.x: Tischauer. And after a while, a lady came in -- we didn't know who she was, but she came in and she looked over the orchestra and she started saying some insulting things in German.
Well, some of the boys, Chappy [Eugene Obendorfer] the drummer, who was of Hungarian origin, he understood it. He understood the German.
